notes: M3 settings card (created 2026-11-04, decision S22). Same flood, satellite and dates as case.json, but a 5 km square so the method can be developed on one part and tested on another. Centre chosen so the box holds Orchid (inside, ~1 km from the east edge), the Chevron/Ikota/VGC/Osapa streets named in news reports, and the Lagos Lagoon edge (JRC GSW: ~15% always-water in the northern 1 km, ~3% in the whole box; checked 2026-11-04).

area.name: 5 km square over central Lekki (Osapa to Orchid, lagoon edge to the north)

context.name: jrc_water_occurrence
context.meaning: Percent of valid months 1984-2021 when Landsat saw water (0-100). JRC masks pixels never seen as water; filled with 0 = never water. Native 30 m, sampled onto our 10 m grid (nearest). Used for 'always water', not as an event label (DATA_AND_VALIDATION.md).

split.why: Decided 2026-11-06 before looking at any flood result (S25). East = test because it holds Orchid and most news-named streets. Checked only that both halves have land and some JRC always-water (west 6.5%, east 0.6%).

labels.how_chosen: 2026-11-06, practice (west) side + wet/dry controls only (S26). change_db = smallest 0.5 dB step where both controls give <=1% false 'louder' on practice land (3.5 dB: wet 0.96%, dry 0.55%). water_db = first whole dB where <=1% of practice land is below it in the smoothed August reference (-17 dB: 0.7% land; catches only 33% of JRC always-water pixels, so the dark-water label is weak here).
